kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نضمحل (form IVq)
# نَضْمَحِلُّ (naḍmaḥillu) /nadˤ.ma.ħil.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
# نَضْمَحِلَّ (naḍmaḥilla) /nadˤ.ma.ħil.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
# نَضْمَحِلِّ (naḍmaḥilli) /nadˤ.ma.ħil.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
